blurb: Silvers Stables provides horseback riding lessons for all skill levels and ages, including a Tiny Tot program for ages 3-4. They offer camps throughout the year, full-service horse training, breeding services for Saddle Seat horses, and sales and consignment of performance horses. The facility includes covered and outdoor arenas and is family-oriented and goal-driven.
extraNote: All lesson fees are processed through an auto draft/Quickbooks system; auto draft form must be sent in before rider can begin lessons · Cancellation and refund policies available in PDF linked on lessons page
